Quick security run: the SOC2 summary looks standard; KMS with customer-managed keys is supported in Redwood Private but we need to confirm one implementation detail: will PerimeterAI manage an external HSM/Key material or do you want Redwood to integrate with your cloud KMS? That affects the timeline by a couple days.

Checklist for us to approve a time-limited subsidy:
1) Signed POC MOU specifying start/end, expected nodes, and liability limits
2) Network diagram (we have it) + CIDR ranges for peering/firewall rules
3) Confirmation of KMS approach (customer KMS vs Redwood-managed)
4) A point of contact for security onboarding (name/email)

Assuming those items, security is comfortable with a short subsidy of up to $8,000 for the pilot with the following constraints:
- Subsidy valid only for the agreed pilot dates (8/10–9/10)
- Redwood will perform a light onboarding review (1–2 business days) before provisioning
- If changes to data classification arise (PII discovered), we reserve the right to pause the pilot until mitigations are in place

Laura — please advise on whether finance needs a PO or if a credit memo plus MOU is sufficient.

-Karthik
